Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Check the Island resources you want, set their stock levels, and let Stock Manager choose the best imported Visland routes automatically. Uses vnavmesh to reach route starts, detects flight and tool access, supports Lifestream travel, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm control commands.
Changelog: Fixed export-cap validation and route-start navigation. Added /sm control commands and per-run collection statistics.
